backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the RevReel app defining all data types (UserProfile, Video, Comment, CarMeet, DirectMessage, Notification, BuildStage, etc.) and including authorization and blob-storage mixins with a hardcoded admin principal.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping a single rollback feature (to Version 22) to its affected frontend files, component dependencies, and test IDs with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose and notable implementation details for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, card, primary, sidebar, chart colors, etc.).
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the RevReel Vite app that mounts the React root div and loads the main TSX module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router setup defining all application routes under a root route, with a layout-wrapped app shell route and a bare landing page route, wrapped in QueryClient and ThemeProvider.
frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx: Component that renders a loading spinner during initialization, a styled login prompt when unauthenticated, or its children when the user has an Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/CarMeetCard.tsx: Card component displaying a car meet's title, category, location, date, and attendee count, with attend/leave toggle buttons for authenticated users and a past-event badge.
frontend/src/components/ChallengeModal.t: A modal dialog that lets the current user select one of their videos to send a challenge to another user, using the postChallenge mutation and displaying loading/error states.
frontend/src/components/CommentsPanel.ts: A slide-in panel that displays sorted comments for a given video and allows authenticated users to post new comments, with relative timestamp formatting.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileModal: A modal form for updating the current user's username, bio, and avatar image, handling file reading and calling the updateProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/FollowButton.tsx: A button component that toggles following/unfollowing a user by calling the appropriate mutation and showing toast notifications for success or failure.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The root layout component that renders the fixed header with navigation links, a mobile nav bar, auth controls, and conditionally shows the ProfileSetupModal for newly authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/PostIssueModal.t: A modal form for posting a car mechanics issue with a title, category selector, and description, submitting via the createMechanicsPost mutation and showing toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/PostListingModal: A modal dialog form for creating a new parts/car listing with fields for title, make, model, year, price, condition, category, image URL, and description, using the useCreateListing mutation.
frontend/src/components/PostMeetModal.ts: A modal dialog form for organizing a car meetup, collecting title, location, date/time, category, and description, then submitting via the useCreateCarMeet mutation with a nanosecond timestamp.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A mandatory (non-dismissible) modal for first-time profile setup, allowing users to enter a username, bio, and optional avatar image, then submitting via the useCreateUser mutation.
frontend/src/components/StartBuildLogMod: A modal dialog form for starting a new car build log with fields for title, make, model, year, and description, submitted via the useCreateBuildLog mutation.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A full-screen video/photo card component that handles autoplay via IntersectionObserver, and provides like, reaction, save, delete, comments panel, and challenge modal interactions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor based on the current Internet Identity, invalidating all dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence via AuthClient, and exposing status flags like isLoggingIn and isLoginSuccess.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines all React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for interacting with the backend canister, along with local TypeScript type definitions for entities like UserProfile, Video, CarMeet, BuildLog, and Listing.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Barlow fonts, sets up Tailwind CSS layers, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark theming, and adds utility classes for neon effects, glass cards, and scrollbar styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: Static About page displaying RevReel's branding, feature list, and a description of the platform, with a copyable CashApp handle for donations.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin-only page protected by AuthGuard that lists all users and allows admins to delete accounts, showing access-denied messaging for non-admins.
frontend/src/pages/BuildLogDetails.tsx: Displays a single build log's details including car info, stages, and author, with owner-only controls to add stages or delete the log.
frontend/src/pages/BuildLogs.tsx: Lists all build logs as cards with car info and stage count, and allows authenticated users to create a new build log via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeetDetails.tsx: Shows detailed information for a specific car meet including date, location, and attendees, with join/leave functionality for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeets.tsx: Displays a filterable list of car meets as cards with attend/leave actions, and lets authenticated users post new meets via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/Classifieds.tsx: Shows a grid of active vehicle/parts listings with images and pricing, and allows authenticated users to post new listings via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/Conversation.tsx: Renders a direct message thread between the current user and another user, supporting sending, deleting, and auto-marking messages as read.
frontend/src/pages/Discover.tsx: Discover page with a debounced search bar that filters videos and users, plus browsable category and hashtag sections derived from all videos.
frontend/src/pages/Feed.tsx: Main feed page that displays all videos sorted by newest first in a vertically snapping scroll container, wrapped in an AuthGuard.
frontend/src/pages/FilteredFeed.tsx: Filtered feed page that shows videos matching a specific category or hashtag, with a sticky header and back navigation to Discover.
frontend/src/pages/Inbox.tsx: Inbox page listing all direct message conversations with unread counts, timestamps, and links to individual message threads, wrapped in an AuthGuard.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Public landing page with a hero section, feature highlights, and an Internet Identity login button that redirects authenticated users to the feed.
frontend/src/pages/Leaderboard.tsx: Leaderboard page showing top trending videos and top racers ranked by total likes, with a banner image and loading state.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetails.tsx: Detail view for a single classifieds listing showing image, price, vehicle info, seller profile, and a remove button for the listing owner.
frontend/src/pages/MechanicsHelp.tsx: Displays a list of mechanics help posts with category filtering and a button to open a post-issue modal for authenticated users. Each post is rendered as a card linking to its detail page.
Shows the full details of a single mechanics help post including its comments, and allows authenticated users to add comments or delete the post if they are the author.
frontend/src/pages/Notifications.tsx: Renders a list of user notifications with read/unread states, supporting mark-all-read and individual mark-read actions, and navigates to the sender's profile on click.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Displays a user's profile page including their videos, saved content, badges, and stats, with support for avatar upload and profile editing for the authenticated owner.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: Provides a form for authenticated users to upload a video or photo with title, description, category, hashtags, and optional thumbnail, tracking upload progress and navigating to the feed on success.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom theme extensions including fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing a rollback fix request to revert backend and frontend files to Version 22 in order to restore broken account recognition and registration behavior.
